description: Full-body native pixel-art game sprite, STRICTLY FRONT SOUTH view: face, nose, chest, belt and knees directly toward viewer, both ears equally visible. No sideways head or three-quarter turn. IDENTITY: Large broad athletic young man with thick chest and shoulders, strong natural limbs. Warm fair skin, broad friendly clean-shaven face, thick dark eyebrows, gray-brown eyes and gentle smile. Thick dark brown wavy side-parted hair with long sweeping curved forelock over one forehead side, short other side. Navy suit stretched over broad shoulders, white shirt, blue tie. No mask. Relaxed upright stance, empty hands at sides. Natural adult anatomy, normal torso/pelvis, 7-head proportions. Anatomical crown to soles 228-234px; feet 6px above bottom, hair fully inside frame. Crisp single-pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained game-sprite shading, no antialiasing. Transparent background, no ground shadow, text or weapons. Preserve individual hair, face, stature and clothing. Do not copy any generic character. Anatomical height excludes high hair/headwear. Every outer edge must border transparency directly, never a light gray halo. Native anatomical crown around y16 and soles y250. Big solid shoulders but naturally built young adult, not a bodybuilder.

style_image.usage_description: Use only tall adult native scale, crisp pixel rendering and front-facing stance. DO NOT COPY bald head, beard, biker jacket, pants, face or colors. Target is a handsome young man with wavy brown hair and navy formal suit.
